scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agrosense/api test && pnpm --filter @agrosense/web test && pnpm db:test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @agrosense/api test:runtime
scripts.deploy:check: pnpm --filter @agrosense/web validate:deploy && pnpm check && pnpm --filter @agrosense/web exec wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: pnpm deploy:check && pnpm deploy:api && pnpm --filter @agrosense/web exec wrangler deploy
